item.text: {"search_note":"Germany’s chancellorship does not operate with fixed term limits in the presidential sense, so the meaningful test here is constitutional transfer and parliamentary confidence, not a formal term-limit clock.\nI did not find evidence of Scholz trying to extend tenure past the constitutional process, block elections, or ignore succession rules.\nThe clearest negative evidence is coalition rupture, not anti-constitutional entrenchment.","evidence":[{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314","summary":"Scholz said he had dismissed Lindner, linked the move to early elections, and asked for a confidence vote. This is evidence that he used the constitutional parliamentary route rather than trying to entrench himself.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Bundestag records Scholz’s Article 68 confidence procedure","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198","summary":"The Bundestag recorded the formal confidence procedure, Scholz’s loss of confidence, and the constitutional path to snap elections. This is direct evidence of respect for succession rules and constitutional transfer.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Bundestag confirms failed confidence vote and path to new elections","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw51-de-vertrauensfrage-1033624","summary":"The official record confirms the government’s managed exit into the election process, not an attempt to override it.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Scholz loses confidence vote, paving way for election","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/german-chancellor-scholz-loses-no-confidence-vote-paving-way-for-election-3773234","summary":"Reuters reported the loss of confidence as the mechanism that opened the way for elections, reinforcing that Scholz accepted constitutional replacement.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Scholz urges calm debate over snap-election timing","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-11-08","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828","summary":"Scholz denied trying to ram through his own agenda and said the timing should still allow a fair and democratic election. This supports respect for orderly succession rather than procedural manipulation.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"German coalition collapses after Scholz fires Lindner","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-11-06","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936","summary":"Firing Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos. This is strong evidence of broken coalition commitments and weakened governing continuity, though not of unconstitutional refusal to transfer power.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"The Guardian: Scholz loses confidence vote triggering early elections","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/16/german-chancellor-olaf-scholz-loses-confidence-vote-triggering-early-elections","summary":"The Guardian reported that Scholz intentionally called a vote he expected to lose in order to trigger elections. That is still consistent with lawful transfer, but it confirms the chancellorship was ending under pressure rather than on a stable coalition basis.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]}]}
